decision: Materialize a provider-neutral Hierarchical + Hybrid Retrieval Fabric under the existing FA3-KNOWLEDGE-001 root and add PageIndex Local as the preferred local provider candidate without creating a new authority or capability.
constraints: FA3-KNOWLEDGE-001 remains the only Knowledge/RAG canonical root
FA3-JOURNAL-001 and original artifacts remain source authorities
PageIndex Local may use only the loopback FA3 Model Router and no direct external model credentials
Cloud PageIndex requires explicit upload approval and Central MCP Gateway mediation
OpenKB may compile derived wiki/entity/concept projections but may not become durable source authority
ConDB may cache/retrieve hierarchical context but all state must be rebuildable from authoritative sources
RetrievalPlan, RetrievalTrace and ContextPassport are required for hybrid reasoning paths
Images, video and audio remain binary artifacts; knowledge stores only derived structured projections and evidence locators
